Kona Saturday Recreational Ride

Kailua-Kona, HI · Road · E-bike

No-dropBeginner friendly

Kona Saturday Recreational Ride is a road and e-bike group ride in Kailua-Kona, HI. It rolls saturdays and Tuesdays at 7:00 am from Kailua-Kona Target parking lot, NW corner. About 24, 35 or 50 round trip miles, casual no-drop tempo, 13–20 mph, rolling hills.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13–20 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @hawaiicyclingclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Kona Saturday Recreational Ride group ride

A casual no-drop ride north on Highway 19 from the Target lot in Kona, with turnarounds at Kua Bay, the scenic overlook or the Waikoloa shops. E-bikes welcome. The Hawaii Cycling Club lists it as a courtesy; it is an informal meet-up with no ride leader.
